text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): BitAuto buying guide describes the 2.0T with 9-speed automatic and 48V mild hybrid as smooth and linear. BitAuto buying guide states the suspension settles body motion quickly over speed bumps. BitAuto buying guide states the E-Class steering is light with vague road feel and lacks the 5 Series' sense of connection, and its acceleration is less aggressive than the 530Li's. BitAuto buying guide warns that a minor service routinely costs over 2,000 yuan and low-profile tyres are expensive to replace. BitAuto buying guide calls the E 260 L 经典版 basically equipped (L1 assistance only, front seat heating optional) and says the E 300 L 时尚型 offers little more equipment than the E 260 L. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «路感模糊»

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): BitAuto contributed article says standard 5G on the 2026 A6L fixes the slow connectivity of the earlier 4G cars. BitAuto contributed article regrets that the 2026 55 TFSI top trim lost its leather-wrapped dashboard, rear sunshade and diamond-quilted front seats. BitAuto contributed article notes the 2026 A6L line-up offers only basic ACC and lane keeping, with no higher-level driver assistance yet.
